message: This batch would take this Mac (synthetic events enter the system event stream). PROCTOR_GUEST names gst-sequoia-01 as the guest it should run on, so the host is refused rather than taken. Reach that guest with proctor_guest action "reach", then drive it through the Proctor running inside it. Running the steps here while naming that guest would be a verdict about the wrong machine.
remedy: Unset PROCTOR_GUEST to allow this batch on this Mac, or reach gst-sequoia-01 with proctor_guest action "reach" and drive it there. Auto-route does not silently take the host.
